# Kdp.Cool

> Free, fast, no-signup web tools for everyday tasks: financial calculators, format converters, developer utilities, and writing helpers. Each tool runs entirely in the browser and shows its math.

## Calculators on this site

- [Mortgage calculator](/mortgage-calculator/): monthly principal and interest, plus a simple tax and insurance draft.
- [Paycheck calculator](/paycheck-calculator/): federal brackets, FICA, optional flat state tax, and pretax deductions.
- [Income tax calculator](/income-tax-calculator/): 2026 US federal ordinary brackets from IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32.

## Other tool families

- [Financial Calculators](https://calc.kdp.cool/): auto loan and compound interest.
- [Format Converters](https://convert.kdp.cool/): time zone (80+ zones with DST), unit (metric ↔ imperial), temperature.
- [Text Utilities](https://text.kdp.cool/): word counter.
- [Developer Tools](https://dev.kdp.cool/): JSON formatter, Base64 encoder.
